hero.tagline: Designing, building, and optimizing software end-to-end.
hero.description: Software Engineering student with practical experience building real-world enterprise products. I am passionate about the complete product lifecycle: from structuring databases and modeling efficient APIs, to deploying containers and polishing interactive user experiences.

about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I am a Software Engineering student committed to building complete, well-rounded software solutions. While my career path started with a strong foundation in backend development, I have actively expanded my focus to a Full Stack role. I enjoy participating in every stage of a product's lifecycle: from understanding the business needs and designing the architecture, to writing stable APIs and refining client-side interfaces.
about.paragraph2: During my time at Devdatep Consulting, I contributed to EmiteFacil, a multi-tenant SaaS billing platform integrated with national tax authorities (SUNAT). Working on a high-availability, business-critical system strengthened my commitment to code quality, error tolerance, and long-term readability.
about.paragraph3: I believe technology should solve real operational problems with elegance. My goal is to keep learning and applying industry standards across cloud infrastructure, clean backends, modern web frontends, and mobile client applications.

internship.bullet1: Designed and implemented RESTful APIs using Laravel 11 and PHP 8.2 following service-oriented architecture (SOA) with Repository and DTO patterns.
internship.bullet2: Integrated digital signatures and SOAP/XML communications with national tax agency (SUNAT) for the EmiteFacil billing platform.
internship.bullet3: Constructed automated business identity validations by integrating third-party governmental query APIs.
internship.bullet4: Secured routes and managed user sessions via Laravel Sanctum, and designed optimized MySQL relational schemas.
